title: Amoxicillin suspension days' supply
formula: Days' supply = total mL ÷ mL per day
prompt: 150 mL bottle; SIG 5 mL t.i.d. Days' supply?
ptceTip: Liquid days' supply uses mL/day, not tablet counts.

title: Insulin units days' supply
formula: Days' supply = units in vial ÷ units per day
prompt: A 10 mL vial of U-100 insulin (1000 units). Patient uses 40 units daily. Days' supply?
ptceTip: U-100 means 100 units/mL — 10 mL = 1000 units.

title: Eye drop quantity estimate
prompt: Using 20 drops/mL, how many mL are needed for 2 drops OU q.i.d. for 7 days?
ptceTip: OU = both eyes; include both eyes in the count.
